hooks.text: 潜入包含52个站点的暗网，扫描网页与源码寻找能救命的隐藏拼图碎片。
hooks.excerpt: Browse the dark net, with access to 52 websites, and uncover hidden pieces to a puzzle that will grant you life... assuming you can find them all.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 与四名NPC竞速交易，可花钱拖慢或永久清除对手，但他们也能用同样手段反击。
hooks.excerpt: Chat with users (NPCs) to buy / sell goods & services. Manage when to progress yourself and when to attack those (NPCs) in the race with you. Pay up to either slow or try to remove them permanently from the competition, but remember they can do the same to you.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 遭入侵时可反黑客赚取DOS币，或升级防火墙求稳，但防守会放弃这笔收益。
hooks.excerpt: Successfully counter hacks to earn DOS Coin OR block intrusions with firewall upgrades, but miss out on earnings. Contend with multiple hacking minigames that will test your reaction speed, typing ability, and puzzle solving skills.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 鼠标与键盘音效细节令人满足。

excerpts.excerpt: the mouse click sounds, keyboard noises, and everything is made so satisfying and sounds awesome
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 游戏在Bug严重的状态下发售。

excerpts.excerpt: released in a buggy state after only brief playtesting
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: UI臃肿且存在大量拼写错误。

excerpts.excerpt: The UI is just so weird, typos everywhere. Very bloated
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 特定网站会造成严重卡顿。

excerpts.excerpt: Specific Websites lag the game to all hell
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 运动传感器会随机失效。

excerpts.excerpt: This game is heavily based on RNG to play
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 缺少动态范围辅助设置。

excerpts.excerpt: Please make an accessibility setting to adjust the dynamic range of the sounds in the game.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段
